items.en: ««Бандероль» на «Иноходце»: против разных целей» (Topwar: 'Banderol on the Inokhodets: against various targets') — Izvestia claims Inokhodets/Orion UAVs strike Ukrainian drone control points, with Banderol cruise missiles in the mix
items.nl: ««Бандероль» на «Иноходце»: против разных целей» (Topwar: 'Banderol op de Inochodets: tegen uiteenlopende doelen') — Izvestija: Inochodets/Orion-drones treffen Oekraïense dronecommandoposten, mede met Banderol-kruisraketten
items.sEn: Topwar (author Kirill Ryabov) builds on a 5 November report by the Russian daily Izvestia, which cites unnamed sources familiar with the combat zone. items.en: Ukrainian Mirage 2000-5F downs Russian S8000 Banderol cruise missile with its cannon for the first time
items.nl: Oekraïense Mirage 2000-5F schiet voor het eerst Russisch S8000 Banderol-kruisvluchtwapen neer met boordkanon
items.sEn: Ukrainian outlet Militarnyi reported on 2 October that a Ukrainian Air Force Mirage 2000-5F has for the first time shot down a Russian S8000 Banderol small cruise missile with its cannon. items.en: Russia's Dan-T munition blurs line between UAVs, cruise missiles — Rostec claims S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T jet drones form a new drone-missile class
items.nl: Russische Dan-T-munitie doet grens tussen UAV's en kruisraketten vervagen — Rostec presenteert S-71M, S-71K en Dan-T als nieuwe klasse tussen drone en raket
